SOU-GUV DAAN LIOUH FUNGX BIEQC BUN SAENGV ZANGC TENGX 
PAAIV SIC (STATE HEARING) YIEM CAUX GUNV GOUX ZORC BAENGC 
SOU-GORN DUQV NGAENGC NZUIH MAIV LAENGZ TENGX 
 
Meih corc haih mborqv finx mingh tov heuc saengv zangc tengx paaiv sic gan fonh:  
1-800-743-8525. Haaix deix mienh longc TDD nyei buonc, mborqv finx heuc  
1-800-952-8349. Meih corc haih tov heuc tengx paaiv sic gan ga’ndiev deix jauv-louc daaih:  
 
• Zoux sou fungx bieqc tov tengx paaiv sic yangh ONLINE yiem lorqc njiec 
WWW.CDSS.CA.GOV  
 
• Meih haih fiev naaiv zeiv sou-guv daan aengx caux fungx gan FAEKV bun taux 
saengv zangc paaiv sic dorngx yangh wangv henh heuc yiem lorqc njiec  
1-833-281-0903 
 
• Fiev ziangx naaiv zeiv sou-guv daan aengx caux fungx EMAIL bun taux 
SCOPEOFBENEFITS@DSS.CA.GOV 
 
• (Mbuox jang-fim waac: Da’faanh meih fungx yangh email, oix zuqc bieqc 
hnyiouv gorngv ninh haih maaih janx-zaqc nimc bieqc doqc mangc dungh mv zeiz 
State Hearings Division haih zoux hoic taux meih nyei email. Tov daaix luic corngh 
longx horpc zuqc longc haaix diuc jauv-louc tengx gem mbueiz liouh fungx meih 
nyei sou-gorn.) 
 
• Meih corc haih dorh naaiv zeiv sou tov taux saengv zangc tengx paaiv sic fungx 
yangh zipv fienx jauv bun taux:  
California Department of Social Services 
State Hearings Division 
744 P Street, MS 9-17-433 
Sacramento, CA 95814 
 
Liouh lorx mienh wangv henh tengx fiev naaiv zeiv sou-guv daan, mborqv finx heuc ei 
nam mber lorz taux ninh mbuo dorng leiz tengx mienh nyei fonh nam mber hietv yiem 
njiec naaiv zeiv tih mengh fienx bun hiuv taux ‘Leiz beu ze’buonc (Your Rights)’  
Bun meih 
 
Yie maiv buatc longx caux naaiv baan njiec lingc dunx nyei waac gorngv taux yie nyei 
zorc baengc jauv-louc. Saengv zangc zorc baengc dorngx, ndie, jaa-sic, a’fai gong-
bou jauv-louc dungh ndie-sai tov taux nyei waac. Yie mv horpc hnyiouv se wueic  
laaix buatc: 
__________________________________________________________________________
__________________________________________________________________________
__________________________________________________________________________
__________________________________________________________________________
_______________________ 
 
(Beiv hnangv meih qiemx longc dorngx jangv liouh fiev, longc ganh kuaaiv lengc jiev zeiv 
fiev aengx caux jau ziex juangc fungx daaih.)

_______________________________________________________________

heng-wangc nyaanh yiem naaiv norm hnoi-nyieqc: ___________________________ 
 
Yie duqv lorz weic tengx faan sic caengz taux yie nyei beu heng-wangc sou-gorn:   
ZEIZ [    ] yiem haaix norm hnoi-nyieqc? __________   MAIV [    ]
